title: Accepting Deposits
content: Has the meaning given in GEN section 2.4.

title: Account Information Service
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 2.32.1(3).

title: Accounting Records
content: Means records and underlying documents comprising initial and other accounting entries and associated supporting documents such as: (a) cheques; (b) records of electronic fund transfers; (c) invoices; (d) contracts; (e) the general and subsidiary ledgers, journal entries and other adjustments to the financial statements that are not reflected in journal entries; and (f) work sheets and spread sheets supporting cost allocations, computations, reconciliations and disclosures.

title: Acting as the Trustee of a Fund
content: Has the meaning given in GEN section 2.25.

title: Acting as the Administrator of an Employee Money Purchase Scheme
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 2.31.1.

title: Actuary
content: An individual who is a ‘Fellow’, or the holder of an equivalent qualification or rank, of a professional actuarial body that is a full member of the International Actuarial Association.

title: Adjusted Capital Resources
content: Capital resources calculated in accordance with PIN Rule A3.2.1.

title: Adjusted Cellular Capital Resources
content: Cellular capital resources calculated in accordance with PIN Rule A5.6.1.

title: Adjusted Fund Capital Resources
content: Fund capital resources calculated in accordance with PIN Rule A7.2.1.

title: Adjusted Non-Cellular Capital Resources
content: Non-cellular capital resources calculated in accordance with PIN Rule A5.2.1.

title: Administrator
content: Means an Authorised Firm Acting as the Administrator of an Employee Money Purchase Scheme.

title: Advice
content: Advice of the type specified in GEN section 2.11 or 2.28.

title: Advising
content: Advising on Credit or Advising on Financial Products.

title: Advising on Credit
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 2.28.1(1)(b).

title: Advising on Financial Products
content: Has the meaning given in GEN section 2.11.

title: Advisor
content: In relation to a Fund, a Person who is retained by the Fund, its Eligible Custodian, a Person providing oversight or its Fund Manager under a commercial arrangement which is not a contract of service: (a) to supply any of them with the advice in relation to the Fund as to the merits of investment opportunities or information relevant to the making of judgments about the merits of investment opportunities; or (b) to exercise for any of the functions concerning the management of the Fund Property.

title: AFN
content: The Applications, Forms and Notices module of the Sourcebook.

title: Agent
content: In relation to a Passported Fund, a Licensed Person appointed by the Fund Manager of the Fund to Promote the Units of that Fund.

title: Algorithmic Token
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 3A.1.1.

title: Alternative Trading System
content: A trading system or facility of a type specified under GEN 2.22.1.

title: AMI
content: The Authorised Market Institutions module of the Rulebook.

title: AML
content: Means either “anti-money laundering” or the Anti-Money Laundering, Counter-Terrorist Financing and Sanctions module depending on the context.

title: Annual Information Return
content: A return prepared by a Registered Auditor for submission to the DFSA in accordance with AUD Rule 4.8.

title: Annual Regulatory Return
content: An annual regulatory return of the type specified in PIN Rule A10.3.1.

title: Approved Asset
content: (1) A certificate of deposit with a maximum term to maturity of six months issued by and held with an Eligible Bank; (2) a term deposit with an Eligible Bank with a remaining term to maturity of one year or less; (3) a negotiable debt instrument, with a remaining term to maturity of five years or less, where the instrument, or issuer thereof, is Rated at least AA- by Standard & Poor’s, or the equivalent by another Rating Agency; (4) a repurchase agreement which is fully collateralised with negotiable debt instruments meeting the rating criterion in (3), and where the credit rating of the counterparty also meets the criteria; or a bond fund meeting the rating criterion in (3) and where the designated bank account for redeemed investment is the an Insurance Bank Account held by the Authorised Firm in accordance with the requirement of COB section 14.3.

title: Approved Prospectus
content: Has the meaning given in MKT Rule 2.6.2(2), 2.7.1(4) and 6.3.2(2).

title: Approved Stock Exchange
content: A stock exchange designated as approved by a written notice from the DFSA, subject to any conditions that the DFSA may specify in that notice.

title: Arranging Credit and Advising on Credit
content: Has the meaning given in GEN section 2.28.

title: Arranging Credit
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 2.28.1(1)(a).

title: Arranging Custody
content: Has the meaning given in GEN section 2.14.

title: Arranging Deals in Investments
content: Has the meaning given in GEN section 2.9.

title: Arranging or Advising on Money Services
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 2.32.1.

title: Associate
content: (1) In Chapters 7 and 11 of GEN and Chapter 8 of AMI means, in respect of a Person ‘A’ holding Shares or entitled to exercise, or control the exercise of voting power, in an Authorised Firm or a Holding Company of an Authorised Firm: (a) the spouse of A;

title: ATS
content: An Alternative Trading System.

title: ATS Operator
content: An Authorised Firm carrying on the Financial Service of Operating an Alternative Trading System for which it has authorisation under its Licence.

title: ATS Traded Fund
content: A Collective Investment Fund, the Units of which are

title: AUD
content: The Auditor module of the Rulebook.

title: Auditor
content: Has the meaning given in Article 97 of the Regulatory Law 2004.

title: Audit Principal
content: Has the meaning given in Article 97 of the Regulatory Law 2004.

title: Audit Services
content: Has the meaning given in Article 97 of the Regulatory Law 2004.

title: Authorised Firm
content: A Person, other than an Authorised Market Institution, who holds a Licence.

title: Authorised Individual
content: An individual who has been authorised by the DFSA to perform one or more Licensed Functions for an Authorised Firm.

title: Authorised ISPV
content: An ISPV which holds a Licence to carry on either or both of the following Financial Services: (a) Effect Contracts of Insurance; or (b) Carry Out Contracts of Insurance

title: Authorised Market Institution
content: A Person who is Licensed by the DFSA in relation to the carrying on either or both of the Financial Services prescribed in GEN Rule 2.17.1 and 2.18.1.

title: Authorised Participant
content: In relation to an ETF, a market maker appointed by the Fund Manager of the ETF for the purposes referred to in CIR Rule 3.1.12 or IFR Rule 6.13.1.

title: Authorised Person
content: An Authorised Firm or an Authorised Market Institution.

title: Bank
content: An Authorised Firm which holds a Licence authorising it to carry on the Financial Service of Accepting Deposits.

title: Base Capital Requirement
content: Has the meaning given in PIB section 3.6.

title: Bearer Share
content: A Share that cannot be registered in the name of the holder and proof of ownership is possession of the Share certificate.

title: Beneficiary
content: Has the meaning given in COB Rule 12.1.2.

title: Bid
content: Includes a Takeover transaction however effected, including a reverse Takeover, partial bid, and also a bid by a parent entity for Shares in its subsidiary.

title: Bidder
content: Includes, but is not limited to, companies wherever incorporated and individuals wherever resident who or which make a Bid under TKO.

title: Bid Document
content: Means a document issued by a Bidder containing information as stipulated under TKO (particularly Chapter 8) and posted in accordance with those Rules (particularly Chapter 11).

title: Bid Period
content: Means the period from the time when an announcement is made of a proposed or possible Bid (with or without terms) until the first closing date or, if this is later, the date when the Bid becomes or is declared unconditional as to acceptances or lapses. An announcement that a holding, or aggregate holdings, of Shares carrying 30% or more of the voting rights of a Reporting Entity is for sale or that the Governing Body of a Reporting Entity is seeking potential Bidders will be treated as the announcement of a possible Bid.

title: Board
content: In reference to the DFSA, the Governing Body of the DFSA, established under Chapter 2 of Part 2 of the Regulatory Law 2004. In reference to a corporation, the Board of Directors of the corporation.

title: Body Corporate
content: Any body corporate, including limited liability partnership and a body corporate constituted under the law of a country or territory outside of the DIFC.

title: Branch
content: A place of business within the DIFC:

title: Business Rules
content: The written rules of an Authorised Market Institution which govern its activities as an Authorised Market Institution.

title: Capital Requirement
content: The amount of capital an Authorised Firm must hold, calculated in accordance with PIB sections 3.3, 3.4 or 3.5, as applicable.

title: Capital Resources
content: The total capital resources of an Authorised Firm calculated in accordance with PIB section 3.11.

title: Captive Insurer
content: A Captive Insurer means a: (a) Class 1 Captive Insurer; (b) Class 2 Captive Insurer; or (c) Class 3 Captive Insurer.

title: Carrying Out Contracts of Insurance
content: Has the meaning given in GEN section 2.16.

title: Category
content: A prudential grouping of Authorised Firms which determines the application of the Rules in PIB.

title: CCP
content: Pursuant to GEN Rule 2.18.1(1)(a), a CCP is a Person who Operates a Clearing House by becoming a Central Counterparty.

title: Cell
content: A cell created by a Protected Cell Company for the purpose of segregating and protecting cellular assets in the manner provided by the PCC Regulations.

title: Cell Return
content: The return described in PIN Rule A10.2.4.

title: Cell Share Capital
content: Capital comprising of the proceeds of the issue of Cell Shares.

title: Cell Shares
content: Shares created and issued by a Protected Cell Company in respect of one of its cells.

title: Cellular Asset
content: The assets of the Protected Cell Company attributable to the Company’s Cells.

title: Cellular Liabilities
content: Liabilities that may be settled by disposition of cellular assets.

title: Central Bank
content: The Central Bank of the U.A.E. or its equivalent in another country or territory.

title: Central Counterparty
content: Pursuant to GEN Rule 2.18.1(3), a Person operates as a Central Counterparty where it:

title: Central Securities Depository
content: In relation to: (a) an Authorised Firm, the meaning given to that term under GEN Rule 2.13.1(3); and (b) in the case of an Authorised Market Institution, the meaning given to that term in GEN Rule 2.18.1(5).

title: Certificate
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule A2.2.1(d).

title: Charge
content: Any Fee or charge made to a Client in connection with Investment Business, whether levied by the Authorised Firm or any other Person, including a Mark-up or Mark- down.

title: Chief Executive (CEO)
content: The individual appointed to the office of Chief Executive of the DFSA by the Board.

title: Chinese Wall
content: An arrangement described in Article 63 of the Markets Law 2012.

title: CIR
content: The Collective Investment module of the Rulebook.

title: Class
content: In relation to a Contract of Insurance, the allocated insurance class as specified in GEN App4.

title: Class 1 Captive Cell
content: A Cell established by a Protected Cell Company to which are attributable assets and liabilities arising out of Insurance Business only in respect of risks related to arising out of the business or operations of members of a Group which together hold a majority of Cell Shares, including for this purpose only contracts of reinsurance in respect of such risks insured by the cedant.

title: Class 2 Captive Cell
content: A Cell established by a Protected Cell Company to which are attributable assets and liabilities arising out of Insurance Business, where: (a) at least 51% of its Gross Written Premium in any year is attributable to risks related to or arising out of the business or operations of the Group which together hold a majority of the Cell Shares; and

title: Class 3 Captive Cell
content: A Cell established by a Protected Cell Company: (a) to which are attributable assets and liabilities arising out of Insurance Business only in respect of risks related to or arising out of the business or operations of persons who engage in similar, related or common: (i) businesses; (ii) activities; (iii) trade; (iv) services; or (v) operations; including for this purpose only contracts of reinsurance in respect of such risks insured by the cedant; and (b) owned by such Persons or by a Body Corporate of which all such Persons are members.

title: Class 1 Captive Insurer
content: A DIFC Incorporated Insurer permitted under the conditions of its licence to effect or carry out Contracts of Insurance only in respect of risks related to or arising out of the business or operations of the Group, including for this purpose only contracts of reinsurance in respect of such risks insured by the cedant.

title: Class 2 Captive Insurer
content: A DIFC Incorporated Insurer which is required under the conditions of its licence to obtain: (a) at least 51% of its Gross Written Premium in any year from Contracts of Insurance in respect of risks related to or arising out of the business or operations of the Group; and (b) the remainder of its Gross Written Premium in any year from Contracts of Insurance in respect of risks related to or arising out of the business or operations of persons who engage by way of business in commercial activities with the Group through related or common: (i) businesses; (ii) activities; (iii) trade; (iv) services; or (v) operations, including, for this purpose only, contracts of reinsurance in respect of such risks insured by the cedant.

title: Class 3 Captive Insurer
content: A DIFC Incorporated Insurer which is: (a) permitted under the conditions of its licence to effect or carry out Contracts of Insurance only in respect of risks related to or arising out of the business or operations of persons who engage in similar, related or common: (i) businesses; (ii) activities; (iii) trade; (iv) services; or (v) operations; including for this purpose only contracts of reinsurance in respect of such risks insured by the cedant, and (b) owned by such Persons or by a Body Corporate of which all such Persons are members.

title: Class of Business
content: A classification of insurance contracts having similar characteristics, specified in GEN App4.

title: Clearing House
content: An Authorised Market Institution which is authorised under its Licence to carry on the Financial Service of Operating a Clearing House.

title: Client
content: A Retail Client, Professional Client or Market Counterparty as defined in COB chapter 2.

title: Client Account
content: (1) In relation to Client Money, an account specified in COB Rule A5.4.1; and (2) in relation to a Safe Custody Investment or Safe Custody Crypto Token, an account specified in COB Rule A6.4.2.

title: Client Agreement
content: An agreement that is made in accordance with the requirements of COB section 3.3

title: Client Assets
content: Client Money, Client Investments and Client Crypto Tokens.

title: Client Assets Crisis Preparedness Pack or Client Assets Pack
content: The documents and records specified in COB section 6.14.

title: Client Crypto Token
content: Has the meaning given in COB Rule 6.13.1A.

title: Client Investments
content: Has the meaning given in COB section 6.13.1.

title: Client Money
content: Has the meaning given in COB section 6.12.

title: Client Money Auditor’s Report
content: A report referred to in GEN Rule 8.6.1(c).

title: Client Money Distribution Rules
content: The Rules under COB section A5.13.

title: Client Money Provisions
content: The provisions under COB App5.

title: Close Links
content: A Person (Person A) has close links with a Person (Person B) if: (a) Person B: (i) is a Holding company of Person A; (ii) is a Subsidiary of Person A; (iii) is a Holding Company of the Subsidiary of Person A; (iv) is a Subsidiary of a Holding Company of Person A; or

title: Close Out Netting
content: A process whereby the claims and obligations of two Counterparties are accelerated, netted to form a single net sum and become immediately due upon the default, bankruptcy, liquidation or other similar circumstance of either of the Counterparties.

title: Close Relative
content: In relation to any individual: (a) his spouse; (b) his children and step-children, his parents and step-parents, his brothers and sisters and his step-brothers and step-sisters; and (c) the spouse of any individual within (b).

title: Closed-ended Fund
content: Has the meaning given in Article 18A(3) of the Collective Investment Law.

title: Closely Related
content: Has the meaning given in PIB Rule A4.11.5.

title: CMC
content: The Code of Market Conduct module of the Sourcebook.

title: COB
content: The Conduct of Business module of the Rulebook.

title: Code of Ethics for Accountants and Audit Firms of Islamic Financial Institutions
content: The code of ethics issued by the Accounting and Auditing Organisation of Islamic Financial Institutions from time to time (AAOIFI).

title: Code of Ethics for Professional Accountants
content: The code of ethics for accountants as issued and amended from time to time by the International Ethics Standard Board for Accountants (IESBA).

title: Collateral
content: (1) In PIB, any form of asset, guarantee, or indemnity which is held or controlled by an Authorised Firm and is subject to a security interest or arrangement in favour of that firm; and (2) In COB, a Client Investment or Client Crypto Token which has been paid for in full by a Client and which is held or controlled by the Authorised Firm under the terms of a deposit, pledge, charge or other security arrangement.

title: Collective Investment Fund
content: An arrangement which amounts to a Fund under Article 11 of the Collective Investment Law 2010 and which is

title: Commercial Paper
content: Debentures with a maturity of less than 2 years at the date of issue.

title: Commission
content: Any form of commission, including a benefit of any kind, offered or given in connection with Investment Business.

title: Commodities Risk Capital Requirement
content: A component of the Market Risk Capital Requirement to cover the risk of holding or taking positions in commodities, including precious metals, but excluding gold, calculated in accordance with PIB section 5.7.

title: Commodity Derivative
content: A Derivative over a commodity.

title: Companies Law
content: DIFC Law No. 5 of 2018 relating to the incorporation of Companies.

title: Complaint
content: Any oral or written expression of dissatisfaction from a Client to an Authorised Firm in connection with the provision of, or failure to provide, a Financial Service to the Client.

title: Compliance Officer
content: In relation to: (a) an Authorised Firm, the Licensed Function described in GEN Rule 7.4.6; and (b) an Authorised Market Institution, the Key Individual function described in AMI Rule 5.3.6.

title: Concentration Risk
content: The risk faced by an Authorised Firm arising out of its Large Exposures.

title: Connected
content: In relation to a Person (A), a Person which has or has at any relevant time had the following relationship to A: (a) a member of A’s Group; (b) a Controller of A; (c) a member of a partnership of which A is a member; (d) an employee or former employee of A; (e) if A is a company: (i) an officer or manager of A or of a parent of A;

title: Connected Counterparties
content: Has the meaning given in PIB Rule A4.11.7.

title: Connected Person
content: In relation to: (a) a Reporting Entity other than that of a Listed Fund, a Person referred to in MKT Rule 4.3.2; and (b) a Reporting Entity of a Listed Fund, a Person referred to in MKT Rule 6.6.1.

title: Constitution
content: (1) In relation to a Fund: (a) which is in the form of a Body Corporate, the instrument of incorporation; (b) which is in the form of a Trust, the trust deed; (c) which is in the form of a Partnership, the partnership deed; or (d) adopting a form other than one specified in (a) to (c), any instrument creating the legal form of the Fund to which the Fund Manager is a party setting out provisions relating to any aspect of the operation or management of the Fund. (2) In relation to an Employee Money Purchase Scheme, has the meaning given in COB Rule 12.1.2.

title: Contingent Liability Investment
content: A Derivative under the terms of which the Client will or may be liable to make further payments (other than Charges, and whether or not secured by margin) when the transaction falls to be completed or upon the earlier closing out of his position.

title: Contract of Insurance
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule A4.1.1.

title: Controller
content: (1) In relation to an Authorised Firm, a Person who, either alone or with any Associate fulfils the criteria specified in GEN Rule 11.8.2; or

title: Convertible
content: An Investment that gives an investor the right to convert the Security into another form of Security at an agreed price or on an agreed basis.

title: Core Benefits
content: Has the meaning given in COB 12.1.2.

title: Corporate Director
content: In relation to an Investment Company that elects to have its sole Corporate Director act as its Fund Manager, the body corporate that acts or intends to act as the Fund Manager.

title: Corporate Governance Principles
content: Principles prescribed in MKT Rules 3.2.3 – 3.2.9.

title: Correspondent Account
content: An account opened on behalf of a Correspondent Banking Client to receive deposits from, to make payments on behalf of or to otherwise handle financial Transactions for or on behalf of the Correspondent Banking Client.

title: Correspondent Bank
content: A bank in a jurisdiction other than the DIFC where an Authorised Firm opens a Correspondent Account.

title: Correspondent Banking Client
content: A Client of an Authorised Firm which uses the firm’s correspondent banking services account to clear Transactions for its own customer base.

title: Counterparty
content: Means any person with or for whom an Authorised Firm carries on, or intends to carry on, any regulated business or associated business. In this context, a counterparty includes an individual, unincorporated body, company, government, local authority or other public body.

title: Counterparty Risk
content: The risk that an Authorised Firm’s Counterparty does not perform its obligations under the terms of a contract.

title: Court
content: The DIFC Court.

title: Credit Default Product
content: A swap or Option, which has a payout linked to changes in an underlying Reference Asset’s creditworthiness and protects the Protection Buyer against the risk of credit loss over a specified time period with the payout being conditional on some form of Credit Event.

title: Credit Derivatives
content: An over the counter financial Derivative instrument, which enables the isolation and separate transfer of Credit Risk and whose payout is linked to changes in the Reference Assets’ creditworthiness.

title: Credit Event
content: An event related to the creditworthiness of Reference

title: Credit Event Payment
content: The consideration, which the Protection Seller pays to the Protection Buyer under a Credit Derivatives contract upon occurrence of a Credit Event.

title: Credit Facility
content: Any facility which includes any arrangement or agreement which extends monetary credit whether funded or unfunded to a Person including but not limited to any loan or syndicated loan, mortgage, overdraft, financial lease, letter of credit, financial guarantee, finance for the acquisition of goods or services, trade finance, transaction finance, project finance, asset finance, or the financing, discounting or factoring of invoices. This definition includes, without limiting the generality of the definition, an arrangement or agreement under which: (a) no, or reduced, interest or charges are payable by the Person to whom credit is extended if that Person repays all or a specified part of the credit on or before a certain date; and (b) if the Person does not make payment in accordance with (a), interest or charges are payable, or are payable at a higher rate, in respect of all or a specified part of the credit. For the purposes of this definition, “monetary credit” means any credit denominated in a national currency, supranational currency or unit of precious metal having a currency designation under the ISO 4217 (being the International Organization of Standardization (ISO) standard for the delineation of currency designation).

title: Credit Fund
content: Has the meaning given in CIR Rule 3.1.15.

title: Credit Provider
content: A Person who provides a Credit Facility.

title: Credit Rating
content: Has the meaning given to it in GEN Rule 2.27.1(2)(b).

title: Credit Rating Activities
content: Has the meaning given to it in GEN Rule 2.27.1(2)(a).

title: Credit Rating Agency
content: A Person carrying on in or from the DIFC the Financial Service of Operating a Credit Rating Agency for which it has an authorisation under its Licence.

title: Credit Risk
content: In relation to an Authorised Firm, the risk of loss if another party fails to perform on its financial obligation to

title: Credit Risk Capital Requirement
content: The requirement calculated in accordance with PIB section 4.6.

title: Credit Spread Option
content: A type of contract where one Counterparty sells an Option to another Counterparty on a nominal amount of an asset swap on a specified Security, exercisable during a set period of time, in exchange for a payment of a premium where the Option gives the buyer the right to put the asset swap back to the seller at a strike spread over a pre-determined benchmark rate.

title: Credit-linked Note
content: A Security whose coupon payments are linked to the return on, and repayment of principal and is linked to the creditworthiness of, the Reference Assets.

title: Crowdfunding Loan Agreement
content: A loan agreement entered into using a Loan Crowdfunding Platform operated by a Crowdfunding Operator.

title: Crowdfunding Operator
content: A Person who is authorised under a Licence to Operate a Crowdfunding Platform.

title: Crowdfunding Platform
content: An Investment Crowdfunding Platform, a Loan Crowdfunding Platform, or a Property Investment Crowdfunding Platform.

title: Crypto Token
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule A2.5.1.

title: Crypto Business
content: Means any one or more of the following Financial Services relating to Crypto Tokens: (a) Dealing in Investments as Principal; (b) Dealing in Investments as Agent; (c) Arranging Deals in Investments; (d) Managing Assets; (e) Advising on Financial Products; (f) Providing Custody; (g) Arranging Custody; or (h) Operating a Multilateral Trading Facility.

title: Crypto Token Derivative
content: A Derivative the value of which is determined by

title: CSD
content: In relation to: (a) an Authorised Firm, a Person who carries on the activity specified in GEN Rule 2.13.1(3); (b) an Authorised Market Institution, a Person who carries on the activity specified in GEN Rule 2.18.1(5).

title: CTF
content: Means counter-terrorist financing.

title: Customer Due Diligence (CDD)
content: Has the meaning in AML Rule 7.3.1.

title: Deal in a Restricted Speculative Investment
content: Has the meaning given in COB Rule 6.16.2.

title: Dealing in Investments as Agent
content: Has the meaning given in GEN section 2.8.

title: Dealing in Investments as Principal
content: Has the meaning given in GEN section 2.7.

title: Debenture
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule A2.2.1(b).

title: Decision Notice
content: a written notice given by the DFSA to a Person pursuant to paragraph 5 of Schedule 3 to the Regulatory Law 2004.

title: Default Rules
content: Rules of an Authorised Market Institution that set out procedures dealing with circumstances where a Member or other participant on its facilities is unable to meet its obligations in respect of one or more contracts.

title: Delegation Agreement
content: An agreement in writing entered into by an Fund Manager or Trustee with a Service Provider in relation to delegated activities, which fulfils the criteria in CIR App 1.

title: Delivery Versus Payment Transaction
content: A transaction in which the transfer of Investments and the payment of Money between the buyer and seller are intended to occur around the same time.

title: Deposit
content: Has the meaning given in GEN section A1.1.

title: Derivative
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule A2.1.3.

title: Derivative Token
content: An Investment Token which is either: (a) a Derivative specified in GEN Rule A2.1.1(2)(b); or (b) an instrument specified in GEN Rule A2.1.1(2)(c) that confers rights and obligations that are substantially similar in nature to those conferred by a Derivative, or has a substantially similar purpose or effect to a Derivative.

title: Designated Fund
content: A Foreign Fund which has been designated by the DFSA under Article 55 of the Collective Investment Law 2010 or, pursuant to Article 1(b) of that law, under Article 20 of the Collective Investment Law 2006.

title: Designated Non-Financial Business or Profession (DNFBP)
content: Has the meaning given in AML Rule 3.2.1.

title: DFSA
content: The Dubai Financial Services Authority.

title: DIFCA Board
content: The Board of Directors of the DIFC Authority.

title: DIFC
content: The Dubai International Financial Centre.

title: DIFC Business Return
content: The return described in PIN Rule A10.2.6.

title: DIFC Business Risk Capital Requirement
content: The capital requirement calculated in accordance with PIN section A9.2.

title: DIFC Incorporated Insurer
content: An Insurer that is a Body Corporate incorporated under the Companies Law.

title: DIFC Registrar of Companies
content: The registrar of companies appointed pursuant to the Companies Law.

title: DIFC Scheme
content: Means an Employee Money Purchase Scheme that is established in the DIFC.

title: Digital Wallet
content: A software application or other tool which is used to control, safeguard or manage public and private cryptographic keys (or their equivalent) associated with Investment Tokens or Crypto Tokens.

title: Digital Wallet Service Provider
content: (1) In relation to an Investment Token, has the meaning given in COB Rule 14.3.1(a); and (2) In relation to a Crypto Token, has the meaning given in COB Rule 15.4.1.

title: Direct Access Member
content: (1) In relation to an Alternative Trading System operated by an Authorised Firm, means a Person that the Authorised Firm admits as a member under COB Rule 9.3.1(1)(e). (2) In relation to a facility operated by an Authorised Market Institution, means a Person that the Authorised Market Institution admits as a Member under AMI Rule 5.7.2(1)(d).

title: Direct Electronic Access
content: Has the meaning given in AMI Rule 5.7.3(3).

title: Direct Long-Term Insurance
content: Long-Term Insurance that is not reinsurance

title: Direct Long-Term Insurance Business
content: The business of Effecting Contracts of Insurance or Carrying Out Contracts of Insurance, where the Contracts of Insurance are contracts of Direct Long- Term Insurance

title: Director
content: (1) In relation to an undertaking established under the DIFC Companies Law, a Person who appears on the Register of Directors maintained by the DIFC Registrar of Companies; and (2) In relation to all other undertakings, a Person who has been admitted to a register which has a corresponding meaning to the Register of Directors or performs the function of acting in the capacity of a Director, by whatever name called.

title: Discretionary Portfolio Management Account
content: An account used by an Authorised Firm to manage the investment portfolio of a Client on a discretionary basis under the terms of a Discretionary Portfolio Management Agreement.

title: Discretionary Portfolio Management Agreement
content: An agreement under which an Authorised Firm agrees with a Client to manage an investment portfolio for that particular Client in accordance with pre-agreed investment parameters in that agreement and where: (a) the Client’s approval of any specific Transaction is not required before undertaking the Transaction; and (b) the assets of the Client are discretely held for that Client and no pooling of those assets occurs with the assets of any other Person, except purely for transactional purposes.

title: Displaced Commercial Risk Capital Requirement (PSIACOM)

title: DLT
content: Distributed Ledger Technology.

title: Domestic Firm

title: Domestic Fund
content: (1) A Fund established or domiciled in the DIFC. (2) In FPR, has the meaning given in section 1.3 of those Rules.

title: Dubai Law
content: Law made by the Ruler, as applicable in the Emirate of Dubai.

title: Effecting Contracts of Insurance
content: Has the meaning given in GEN section 2.15.

title: Eligible Bank
content: Means: (a) a Bank; (b) a legal entity that is authorised to accept deposits and supervised by the Central Bank of the State; or (c) a legal entity that is: (i) authorised to accept deposits and supervised by a Financial Services Regulator in a jurisdiction outside the State; and (ii) Rated at least A- by Standard & Poor’s, or the equivalent by another Rating Agency.

title: Eligible Custodian
content: Has the meaning given in CIR Rule 8.2.4

title: Eligible Security
content: A Share, Debenture, Certificate over a Share or Debenture, Warrant over a Share or Debenture or a Unit that is a share representing the rights or interests of a Unitholder in a Fund.

title: Employee
content: An individual: (a) who is employed or appointed by a Person in connection with that Person's business, whether under a contract of service or for services or otherwise; or (b) whose services, under an arrangement between that Person and a third party, are placed at the disposal and under the control of that Person.

title: Employee Money Purchase Scheme
content: Has the meaning given in Schedule 1 to the Regulatory Law.

title: Employee Share Scheme

title: Employment Law
content: The DIFC Employment Law 2019.

title: Employment Regulations
content: The Regulations made under the DIFC Employment Law as amended from time to time.

title: Error Trade

title: ETF Fund Manager

title: Exchange Traded Fund
content: Has the meaning given in CIR Rule 3.1.12.

title: Excluded Token

title: Execute

title: Exempt Communications

title: Exempt Securities

title: Expenditure Based Capital Minimum
content: A capital requirement calculated in accordance with PIB section 3.7.

title: Exposure
content: The maximum loss that an Authorised Firm (and, where applicable, its PSIA holders) might suffer as a result of the default or failure of a Counterparty, or a group of Closely Related Counterparties or an issuer or group of Closely Related issuers.

title: External Fund
content: Has the meaning given in Article 14 of the Collective Investment Law 2010.

title: External Fund Manager
content: Has the meaning given in Article 20(5) of the Collective Investment Law 2010.

title: Family
content: Has the meaning given to that term in the Family Arrangement Regulations.

title: Family Entity
content: Has the meaning given to that term in the Family Arrangement Regulations.

title: Family Structure
content: Has the meaning given to that term in the Family Arrangement Regulations.

title: Family Office
content: Has the meaning given to that term in the Family Arrangement Regulations.

title: Family Office Services
content: Has the meaning given to that term in the Family Arrangement Regulations.

title: Fee

title: Feeder Fund
content: Has the meaning given in CIR Rule 3.1.4.

title: Fiat Crypto Token
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule A2.5.5.

title: Finance Officer
content: In relation to: (a) an Authorised Firm, the Licensed Function described in GEN Rule 7.4.5; and (b) an Authorised Market Institution, the Key Individual function described in AMI Rule 5.3.5.

content: An intergovernmental body responsible for developing and promoting policies to combat money laundering and terrorist financing.

title: Financial Free Zone

title: Financial Group Capital Requirement

title: Financial Group Capital Resources
content: The Capital Resources of a Financial Group calculated in accordance with PIB Rule 8.3.4 or PIN 8.3.4.

title: Financial Institution

title: Financial Instrument

title: Financial Markets Tribunal

title: Financial Promotion
content: Has the meaning given in Article 41A(3) of the Regulatory Law 2004.

title: Financial Promotions Prohibition
content: Has the meaning given in Article 41A(1) of the Regulatory Law 2004.

title: Financial Service

content: A report referred to in GEN Rule 8.6.1(a).

title: Foreign Fund
content: A Fund established or domiciled in a jurisdiction other than the DIFC.

content: A price calculated by reference to the valuation point next following the fund manager's agreement to sell or, as the case may be, to redeem the units in question.

title: FSRA
content: The Financial Services Regulatory Authority of the Abu Dhabi Global Market.

title: Fund
content: (1) A Collective Investment Fund. (2) In relation to a Passported Fund, has the meaning given in FPR section 1.3.

title: Fund Administrator
content: An Authorised Firm which is authorised under its Licence to Provide Fund Administration or a Person who is authorised or licensed by a Financial Service Regulator to provide such administration.

title: Fund Auditor’s Report
content: A report referred to in CIR Rule 9.3.8(b).

title: Fund Manager
content: (1) The Person, described under Article 20(4) of the Collective Investment Law 2010, who is responsible for the management of the property held for or within a Fund and who otherwise operates the Fund and, in relation to a Domestic Fund, is authorised under a Licence granted by the DFSA to operate the Fund. content: Has the meaning given in CIR Rule 3.1.3

content: Liabilities of an Insurer arising under or associated with contracts of General Insurance entered into by it, as insurer or cedant, including liabilities in respect of claims (whether or not incurred), acquisition costs and claims settlement costs.

title: GLO

content: (1) The board of directors, partners, committee of management or other governing body of an Undertaking. (3) In AML, has the meaning in Rule 3.2.1.

content: In relation to an Insurer as at a date, the amount of the Insurer’s provision for claims incurred but not yet paid as at that date, including claims incurred but not yet reported and provision for direct and indirect claims settlement expenses in respect of those claims.

content: (1) In relation to a Contract of Insurance, the amount of premium payable by the insured in respect of that contract, excluding any excise taxes levied on premiums and receivable by the Insurer but without any deduction for commissions or other acquisition expenses; and (2) in relation to an Insurer during a period: (a) in respect of General Insurance, the aggregate amount of Gross Written Premium in respect of insurance and reinsurance contracts entered into by the Insurer as insurer during that period, together with any adjustments arising in that period in respect of contracts effected in previous periods; and (b) in respect of Long-Term Insurance, the aggregate amount of Gross Written

title: Group
content: (1) Means a group of entities which includes an entity (the ‘first entity’) and: (a) any Parent of the first entity; and (b) any Subsidiary of the first entity or of any Parent of the first entity. (2) In AML, has the meaning in Rule 3.2.1.

title: Group Risk
content: The risk of loss to the Authorised Firm as a result of its membership of, or linkages within a Group.

title: Guidance
content: Has the meaning given in Article 2 of Schedule 1 to the Regulatory Law 2004.

title: Hedge Fund
content: Has the meaning given in CIR Rule 3.1.9

title: Historic Price
content: A price calculated by reference to the valuation point immediately preceding the fund manager's agreement to sell or, as the case may be, to redeem the units in question.

title: Holding Company
content: Has the meaning given in Schedule 1 to the Companies Law and, without limiting the generality of that definition, is taken to include, in relation to a relevant Body Corporate (the Subsidiary), the Subsidiary’s ultimate Holding Company and any Holding Company between the Subsidiary and the Subsidiary’s ultimate Holding Company.

content: Has the meaning given in FPR section 1.3.

content: The IFRS for SMEs Accounting Standard, as issued and amended from time to time by the International Accounting Standards Board.

title: iNAV
content: Indicative Net Asset Value of an ETF.

content: An Incorporated Cell of an Incorporated Cell Company, created in accordance with the ICC Regulations.

title: Incorporated Cell Company (ICC)
content: A company incorporated as an Incorporated Cell Company under the ICC Regulations.

title: ICC Regulations
content: The Incorporated Cell Company (ICC) Regulations made under the DIFC Companies Law.

title: Independent Valuer
content: A Person who carries on the business or profession of valuing Real Property and who meets the criteria set out under CIR Rule 13.4.19.

title: Initial List
content: The Initial List of Recognised Crypto Tokens published by the DFSA under GEN Rule 3A.4.1, as amended from time to time.

title: Inside Information
content: Information specified in Article 63(1)(a) of the Markets Law 2012.

title: Insider
content: A Person specified in Article 63(1)(b) of the Markets Law 2012.

title: Instrument
content: Means, in relation to a Derivative, any Investment, asset or thing on which the value of the Derivative may be based.

title: Insurance Agent
content: A Person who acts as an agent of one or more insurers.

title: Insurance Aggregation Site
content: A website or other form of electronic media that provides a facility by means of which a Person can: (a) search for a Contract of Insurance according to selected criteria; (b) identify, obtain a quote for, compare, or obtain a list ranking one or more Contracts of Insurance in response to the search; and (c) conclude, directly or indirectly, a Contract of Insurance.

title: Insurance Bank Account
content: A bank account with an Eligible Bank which has been opened by an Insurance Intermediary or Insurance Manager in accordance with COB Rule 7.12.5.

title: Insurance Broker
content: A Person who acts as an agent of a Policyholder in relation to a Contract of Insurance.

title: Insurance Business
content: The business of Effecting Contracts of Insurance or Carrying Out Contracts of Insurance, including effecting or carrying out contracts of reinsurance (as reinsurer).

title: Insurance Fund
content: In relation to a Takaful Insurer, the aggregate of the assets and liabilities of the Insurer that are attributed to the Takaful transactions of the Insurer and the amount of any assets designated by the Insurer as a capital transfer to the insurance fund; and includes the amount of any profit, surplus or return (however called or described), less attributable expenses, arising on the investment of such funds.

title: Insurance Intermediary
content: An Authorised Firm whose Licence authorises it to carry on the Financial Service of Insurance Intermediation.

title: Insurance Intermediation
content: Has the meaning given in GEN section 2.19.

title: Insurance Liabilities
content: General Insurance liabilities and Long-Term Insurance liabilities.

title: Insurance Management
content: Has the meaning given in GEN section 2.20.

title: Insurance Manager
content: An Authorised Firm whose Licence authorises it to carry on the Financial Service of Insurance Management.

title: Insurance Monies
content: Has the meaning given in COB Rule 7.12.2.

title: Insurance Monies Auditor’s Report
content: A report referred to in GEN Rule 8.6.1(d).

title: Insurance Special Purpose Vehicle

title: International Standards on Auditing
content: The international standards on auditing as issued and amended from time to time by the International Auditing and Assurance Standards Board (IAASB).

title: International Standards on Quality Management
content: The international standards on quality management as issued and amended from time to time by the International Auditing and Assurance Standards Board (IAASB).

title: International Standards on Related Services
content: The international standards on related services as issued and amended from time to time by the International Auditing and Assurance Standards Board (IAASB).

content: Any asset, right or interest of an Insurer that is held by the Insurer for the primary purpose of generating revenues or for directly providing funds to meet the Insurer’s cash outflows in the future.

title: Investment

title: Investment Analyst
content: An Employee of an Authorised Firm who prepares Investment Research.

title: Investment Business (h)
content: The business of: (a) Dealing in Investments as Principal; (b) Dealing in Investments as Agent; (c) Arranging Deals in Investments; (d) Managing Assets; (e) Advising on Financial Products; (f) Managing a Collective Investment Fund; (g) Providing Custody;

title: Investment Company
content: An open or closed ended company established for the main purpose of collective investment which is incorporated under of the Companies Law in accordance with the Regulations made under that Law.

content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rules 2.29.1(4) and (6).

title: Investment Crowdfunding Operator
content: A Person who is authorised under a Licence to Operate an Investment Crowdfunding Platform.

title: Investment Crowdfunding Platform
content: An electronic platform or a facility referred to in GEN Rule 2.29.1(4) or (6).

title: Investment Manager
content: A Person who, acting only on behalf of a Client: (a) manages Investments or Crypto Tokens in an account or portfolio on a discretionary basis under the terms of a discretionary management agreement; or (b) manages Investments or Crypto Tokens in an account or portfolio on a non-discretionary basis under the terms of a non-discretionary management agreement.

title: Investment Partnership
content: A limited partnership established for the main purpose of collective investment which is formed and registered under the Limited Partnership Law in accordance with the Regulations made under that Law.

title: Investment Platform
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 2.31.1

title: Investment Research
content: A publication which contains: (a) the results of research into Investments or Crypto Tokens; (b) analysis of factors likely to influence the future performance of Investments or Crypto Tokens; or (c) advice or recommendations based on those results or analysis.

title: Investment Risk Reserve
content: Represents the amount that is appropriated out of the income of investment account holders, after allocating the Mudarib’s share, in order to meet future losses attributable to investment account holders.

title: Investment Token
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule A2.1.1(3).

title: Investment Token Fund
content: Has the meaning given in CIR Rule 3.1.14.

title: Investment Trust
content: An express trust created mainly for collective investment purposes under the Investment Trust Law.

title: Investment Undertaking
content: An Investment Company, Investment Partnership, or Investment Trust which is used as the investment vehicle for a Fund.

title: Investment-Linked Insurance
content: Contracts of Insurance where the benefits are wholly or partly to be determined by reference to the value of, or the income from, property of any description (whether or not specified in the contracts) or by reference to fluctuations in, or in an index of, the value of property of any description (whether or not so specified).

title: IOSCO
content: The International Organisation of Securities Commissions.

title: IFR
content: The Islamic Finance Rules module of the Rulebook.

title: Islamic Accounting and Auditing Standards
content: The auditing and accounting standards issued by the Accounting and Auditing Organisation of Islamic Financial Institutions (AAOIFI).

content: Any contract designed to comply with Shari’a.

content: Has the meaning given in IFR Rule 6.13.1.

content: Has the meaning given in CIR Rule 3.1.2

title: Islamic Window

title: Issuer
content: (1) (in relation to any Security) (other than a Unit in a Collective Investment Fund) the Person by whom it is or is to be issued; (2) (in relation to a Unit in a Collective Investment Fund) the Fund Manager; (3) (in relation to an interest in a limited Partnership) the Partnership; and (4) (in relation to Certificates) the Person who issued or is to issue the Security to which the Certificate or other instrument relates.

title: Joint Forum
content: The Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS), the International Organization of Securities Commissions (IOSCO) and the International Association of Insurance Supervisors (IAIS).

title: Key Individual
content: An individual who has been authorised by the DFSA to perform one or more Licensed Functions for an Authorised Market Institution.

title: Key Information
content: Information prescribed in MKT Rule in 2.5.2(1)(b).

title: Large Exposure
content: An Exposure, whether in an Authorised Firm’s Non- Trading Book or Trading Book, or both, to a Counterparty or Group of Closely Related Counterparties or a Group of Counterparties connected to the Authorised Firm which in aggregate is equal to or exceeds 10% of the Authorised Firm’s Tier 1 Capital.

title: Licence
content: A Licence granted by the DFSA under Chapter 2 of Part 3 of the Regulatory Law 2004.

title: Licensed Director
content: The Licensed Function described in GEN Rule 7.4.3.

title: Licence Endorsement
content: an endorsement made by the DFSA on a Licence that permits an Authorised Person to carry on an activity prescribed under Article 44 of the Regulatory Law 2004.

title: Licensed Function
content: (1) in relation to an Authorised Firm, a function described in GEN section 7.4; and (2) in relation to an Authorised Market Institution, a function described in AMI section 5.3.

title: Licensed Partner
content: The Licensed Function described in GEN Rule 7.4.4.

title: Licensed Person
content: In relation to a Passported Fund, a Person who is licensed or otherwise authorised by the Home Regulator to Promote Funds.

title: Licensing Requirements
content: The requirements set out in AMI section 7.2 in relation to the granting of a Licence to an Authorised Market Institution.

title: Limited Liability Partnership
content: A partnership incorporated under the Limited Liability Partnership Law 2004 or under the law of a country or territory outside the DIFC.

content: The Official List of Securities.

content: Has the meaning given in MKT Rule 9.1.1(2).

title: Listed Fund
content: A Collective Investment Fund which has been admitted to the Official List of Securities.

title: Listed Securities

content: Means the Rules in MKT section 9.2.

content: The Rules in chapter 9 of MKT.

content: An underwriting member of Lloyds.

content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rules 2.29.1(2) and (3).

content: A Person who is authorised under a Licence to Operate a Loan Crowdfunding Platform.

title: Loan Crowdfunding Platform

title: Local Authorities
content: Government or municipal authorities, which do not operate at a national level.

title: Long-Term Insurance Business
content: The business of Effecting Contracts of Insurance or Carrying Out Contracts of Insurance, where the Contracts of Insurance are contracts of Long-Term Insurance.

title: Long-Term Insurance Fund
content: A fund in respect of Long-Term Insurance Business established and maintained in accordance with PIN chapter 3.

title: Long-Term Insurance Liabilities
content: Liabilities of an Insurer arising under or associated with contracts of Long-Term Insurance, entered into by it as insurer or cedant, including liabilities of the kinds referred to in PIN Rules 5.6.6 and 5.6.7.

title: Major Acquisition
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 11.10.8(3).

title: Managing Assets

content: Has the meaning given in GEN section 2.12.

content: Conduct which contravenes a provision contained in chapter 1 of Part 6 of the Markets Law 2012.

title: Market Counterparty
content: A Client specified under COB Rule 2.3.9.

title: Market Price
content: The price at which the Shares are being traded on an Authorised Market Institution.

title: Market Risk
content: The risk of loss that arises from fluctuations in the values of, or income from, assets or in interest or exchange rates.

title: Market Risk Capital Requirement
content: The requirement calculated in accordance with PIB Rule 5.3.1.

title: Markets Law
content: The Markets Law 2012

title: Markets Rules

title: Maturity Mismatch
content: A difference between the maturity of an asset and the corresponding liability.

title: Member
content: (1) In relation to an Authorised Market Institution, a person admitted as a member of the Authorised Market Institution in accordance with its Business Rules. (2) In relation to an Employee Money Purchase Scheme, has the meaning given in GEN Rule 2.30.1.

title: Minimum Capital Requirement
