title: Minimum Cellular Capital Requirement
content: The Minimum Segmental Capital Requirement in respect of a cell.

title: Minimum Fund Capital Requirement
content: The requirement calculated in accordance with PIN Rule A8.2.1.

title: Minimum Non-Cellular Capital Requirement
content: The Minimum Segmental Capital Requirement in respect of that part of a protected cell company that is not a cell.

title: Minimum Segmental Capital Requirement
content: The requirement calculated in accordance with PIN section A6.2.

title: MKT
content: The Markets module of the Rulebook.

title: Money
content: Any form of money, including cheques and other payable orders.

title: Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO)
content: (1) For the purposes of AMI, the Key Individual function described in AMI Rule 5.3.8. (2) For the purposes of an Authorised Firm other than a Credit Rating Agency, the Licensed Function described in GEN Rule 7.4.8. (3) For all other purposes, has the meaning in AML Rule 3.2.1.

title: Money Market Fund
content: Has the meaning given in CIR Rule 3.1.11.

title: Money Services
content: The services referred to in GEN Rule 2.6.1

title: Money Services Auditor’s Report
content: A report referred to in GEN Rule 8.6.1(g).

title: Money Services Provider
content: A Person that Provides Money Services.

title: Money Transmission
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 2.6.1(2).

title: MTF
content: A Multilateral Trading Facility.

title: MTF Operator
content: An Authorised Firm that is authorised under its Licence

title: Multilateral Trading Facility
content: Pursuant to GEN Rule 2.22.1(a), a system which brings together multiple third party buying and selling interests in Investments or Crypto Tokens, in accordance with its non-discretionary rules, in a way that results in a contract in respect of such Investments or Crypto Tokens.

title: Net Outstanding Claims
content: In respect of an Insurer as at a date, Gross Outstanding Claims of the Insurer as at that date, less the amount of reinsurance and other recoveries expected to be received in respect of those claims.

title: Net Written Premium
content: In respect of an Insurer during a period, Gross Written Premium of the Insurer during that period less the amount of premium on reinsurance contracts entered into by the Insurer as cedant during the same period.

title: Netting by Novation
content: The process of automatically amalgamating some or all claims and obligations between two Counterparties to create a single new claim or obligation replacing the relevant former claims or obligations.

title: Nominee Company
content: A company incorporated in the DIFC whose business consists solely of acting as a holder of Client Assets where such assets are held by the Nominee Company as agent of an Authorised Firm.

title: Non-Cellular Assets
content: Assets of a Protected Cell Company which are not Cellular Assets.

title: Non-Cellular Liabilities
content: Liabilities that may not be settled by disposition of cellular assets.

title: Non-DIFC insurer
content: A Person, other than an Insurer, who is authorised and supervised as an insurer by a Financial Services Regulator.

title: Non-DIFC Scheme
content: Means an Employee Money Purchase Scheme or any similar scheme or arrangement that is established outside the DIFC.

title: Non-Fungible Token (NFT)
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule A2.5.3.

title: Non-Performing
content: (1) In the case of loans and other financial instruments to which an Authorised Firm is exposed, having either of the following qualities: (a) Contractual payments of interest or principal are 90 days or more past the date on which they were due and payable, and the current value of any security held in respect of the loan or other financial instrument is insufficient, after making allowance for expenses of realisation, to meet the total amount of principal and accrued interest; or

title: Non-Trading Book
content: Describes positions, exposures and on-and off-balance sheet items, which are not in the Trading Book.

title: Notice of Objection
content: A notice filed by a Person who has received a Notice of Administrative Censure or a Notice of Administrative Fine who objects to the imposition of the censure or fine as the case may be.

title: Offer
content: (1) In relation to Securities other than Units, an offer of Securities falling within Article 12 of the Markets Law 2012. (2) In relation to Units, an offer of Units falling within Article 19 of the Collective Investment Law 2010.

title: Offer of Crypto Tokens to the Public
content: Has the meaning given in Article 12 of the Markets Law 2012.

title: Offer of Securities to the Public
content: Has the meaning given in Article 12 of the Markets Law 2012.

title: Offer to the Public
content: In relation to Crypto Tokens, means an Offer of Crypto Tokens to the Public.

title: Offer Period
content: The period during which an Offer of Securities to the Public made pursuant to a Prospectus remains open to investors.

title: Offer Price
content: The price at which the Shares were offered and accepted under the offer document. In the event that an auction process was used to determine the offer price, then that price is the offer price.

title: Offeree
content: A Person to whom an Offer of Securities is made.

title: Offeror
content: A Person who makes an Offer of Securities.

title: Official List of Securities
content: A list of Securities maintained by the DFSA in accordance with the Markets Law 2012.

title: Open-ended Fund
content: Has the meaning given in Article 18A(2) of the Collective Investment Law.

title: Operating a Clearing House
content: Has the meaning given in GEN section 2.18.

title: Operating a Crowdfunding Platform
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 2.29.1.

title: Operating an Employee Money Purchase Scheme
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 2.30.2.

title: Operating a Facility for Crypto Tokens
content: (1) In relation to an Authorised Market Institution, means carrying on either or both of the following activities: (a) Operating a Multilateral Trading Facility on

title: Operating a Facility for Investment Tokens
content: (1) In relation to an Authorised Market Institution, means carrying on one or more of the following activities: (a) Operating an Exchange on which Investment Tokens are traded; (b) Operating a Clearing House on which Investment Tokens are cleared; or (c) Operating a Multilateral Trading Facility on which Investment Tokens are traded. (2) In relation to an Authorised Firm, means Operating an Alternative Trading System on which Investment Tokens are traded.

title: Operating a Loan Crowdfunding Platform
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rules 2.29.1(2) and (3).

title: Operating a Property Investment Crowdfunding Platform
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rules 2.29.1(5) and (6).

title: Operating an Alternative Trading System
content: Has the meaning given in GEN section 2.22.

title: Operating an Exchange
content: Has the meaning given in GEN section 2.17.

title: Operating an Investment Crowdfunding Platform
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rules 2.29.1(4) and (6).

title: Operator
content: Has the meaning given in COB Rule 12.1.2

title: Option
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule A2.3.1(a).

title: Ordinary Resolution
content: In relation to a company, a resolution passed by a simple majority of such shareholders of that company as (being entitled to do so) vote in person or, where proxies are allowed, by proxy, at a general meeting for which notice specifying the intention to propose the resolution has been duly given.

title: Organised Trading Facility
content: Pursuant to GEN Rule 2.22.1(b), a system which brings together multiple third party buying and selling interests in Investments, in accordance with its discretionary rules, in a way that results in a contract in respect of such Investments.

title: OTF
content: An Organised Trading Facility.

title: Outsourcing Agreement
content: An agreement in writing entered into by an Fund Manager or Trustee with a Service Provider in relation to outsourced functions, which fulfils the criteria in CIR App 1.

title: Own Account Transaction
content: A transaction Executed by the Authorised Firm for its own benefit or for the benefit of its Associate.

title: Owner’s Equity
content: In relation to a Takaful Insurer, the amount of the assets, less the liabilities, of the Insurer that are not attributed to the insurance fund of the Insurer.

title: Parent
content: A Holding Company.

title: Participating Employer
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 2.30.1.

title: Partner
content: In relation to an Undertaking which is a Partnership, a Person occupying the position of a partner, by whatever name called.

title: Partnership
content: Any partnership, including a partnership constituted under the law of a country or territory outside the DIFC, but not including a Limited Liability Partnership.

title: Passported Fund
content: Has the meaning given in FPR section 1.3.

title: Payment Account
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 2.6.1(2)

title: Payment Account Provider
content: A Person that provides or operates a Payment Account.

title: Payment Initiation Service
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 2.32.1(4).

title: Payment Instrument
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 2.6.1(2)

title: Payment Order
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 2.6.1(2).

title: Payment Schedule
content: Has the meaning given in COB Rule 12.1.2.

title: Payment Service
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 2.6.1(2).

title: Payment Service Provider
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 2.6.1(2).

title: Payment Transaction
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 2.6.1(2).

title: Permanent Health Insurance
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule A4.1.2(d).

title: Permanent Share Capital
content: Ordinary paid-up share capital or similar shareholders’ or members’ equity, including retained earnings, however called.

title: Person
content: A Person includes any natural person, Body Corporate or body unincorporated, including a legal person, company, Partnership, unincorporated association, government or state.

title: Personal Account Transaction
content: A transaction undertaken by an Employee of an Authorised Firm in an Investment or Crypto Token, other than: (a) a transaction in a government and public Security;

title: Persons Undertaking Key Control Functions
content: Persons undertaking compliance, risk management, internal audit and similar control functions.

title: PIB
content: The Prudential - Investment, Insurance Intermediation and Banking module of the Rulebook.

title: PIN
content: The Prudential – Insurance Business module of the Rulebook.

title: Policyholder
content: Includes a potential policyholder.

title: Policy Benefit
content: An amount payable under an insurance contract as a result of the occurrence of an event insured under the contract.

title: Politically Exposed Person (PEP)
content: Means a natural person (and includes, where relevant, a family member or close associate) who is or has been entrusted with a prominent public function, including but not limited to, a head of state or of government, senior politician, senior government, judicial or military official, ambassador, senior executive of a state owned corporation, or an important political party official, but not middle ranking or more junior individuals in these categories.

title: Preliminary Notice
content: a written notice given by the DFSA to a Person pursuant to paragraph 4(1) of Schedule 3 to the Regulatory Law 2004.

title: Premium Liability
content: The liability referred to in PIN Rule 5.4.7.

title: Price Information Provider
content: (1) In CIR, has the meaning given to that term in CIR Rule 13.9.4(2). (2) In AMI, has the meaning given to that term in Rule A2.1.2(2).

title: Price Sensitive Information
content: Information of a type which is liable to cause substantial movement in the price of Securities or (in the case of Debentures) to affect significantly the ability of the Issuer to meet its commitments.

title: Price Stabilisation
content: The activity of stabilising the price of an Eligible Security in the manner described in the PRS Module.

title: Principal Representative
content: An individual designated by a Representative Office in accordance with REP.

title: Principle
content: (1) In relation to an Authorised Firm or Authorised Individual, a principle prescribed in GEN chapter 4. (2) In relation to a Registered Auditor, a principle prescribed in AUD section 2.3A. (3) In relation to an Audit Principal, a principle prescribed in AUD section 2.6.

title: Privacy Device
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 3A.1.1.

title: Privacy Token
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 3A.1.1.

title: Private Equity Fund
content: Has the meaning given in CIR Rule 3.1.6

title: Private Placement
content: An Offer made to a Person who is likely to be interested in the Offer having regard to: (i) previous contact between the Person making the Offer and that Person; (ii) a professional or other connection between the Person making the Offer and that Person; or (iii) statements or actions by that Person that indicate that he is interested in Offers of that kind.

title: Private Trust Company
content: Means a body corporate the purpose of which is solely to provide trust business services in respect of a specific trust or trusts: (a) of which a Family Member of a Family or a Family Entity related to a Family is the settlor; and (b) the beneficiaries are all persons referred to in paragraphs (a) to (d) of Rule 2.5.2 of the Family Arrangement Regulations.

title: Privileged Communication
content: A privilege arising from the provision of professional legal advice and any other like privilege properly applicable at law to the communication in question, but does not include a general duty of confidentiality.

title: Professional Client
content: A Client specified under COB Rule 2.3.3.

title: Profit Equalisation Reserve
content: Represents the amount appropriated out of the Mudaraba income, before allocating the Mudarib’s share, in order to maintain a certain level of investment returns for investment account holders and to increase owners’ equity.

title: Profit Sharing Investment Account (PSIA)
content: An account or portfolio managed: (a) in relation to property of any kind, including the currency of any country or territory, held for or within the account or portfolio; (b) in accordance with Shari’a and held out as such; and (c) under the term of an agreement whereby: (i) the investor agrees to share any profit with the manager of the account or portfolio in accordance with a predetermined specified percentage or ratio; and (ii) the investor agrees that he alone will bear any losses in the absence of negligence or breach of contract on the part of the manager.

title: Promote
content: In relation to a Passported Fund, has the meaning given in FPR section 1.3.

title: Property
content: (1) In relation to AML, has the meaning given in Articles (1) and (2) of the U.A.E. Federal Law No.20 of 2018; and (2) In relation to Property Investment Crowdfunding, has the meaning given in GEN Rule 2.29.1(7).

title: Property Fund
content: Has the meaning given in CIR Rule 3.1.7

title: Property Investment Crowdfunding
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rules 2.29.1(5) and (6).

title: Property Investment Crowdfunding Operator
content: A Person who is authorised under a Licence to operate a Property Investment Crowdfunding Platform.

title: Property Investment Crowdfunding Platform
content: An electronic platform or a facility referred to in GEN Rules 2.29.1(5) and (6).

title: Property Related Assets
content: Assets which are Shares, Debentures or Warrants which are issued by a Body Corporate, a substantial activity of which relates to investment in Real Property and Certificates which confer rights in respect of such Investments.

title: Prospectus
content: (1) In relation to an Offer of Securities to the Public, a document containing the information specified in Article 15 of the Markets Law 2012 and the MKT Rules, and includes a Supplementary Prospectus. (2) In relation to a Fund, a document containing the information prescribed under the Collective Investment Law 2010 and the CIR Rules, including a Short Form Prospectus or Supplementary Prospectus.

title: Prospectus Offer
content: An Offer of Securities referred to in Article 14(4)(a) of the Markets Law 2012.

title: Protected Cell Company
content: A company incorporated as, or converted into, a Protected Cell Company in accordance with the provisions of the Regulations made under the Companies Law.

title: Protection Buyer
content: The Counterparty to a Credit Derivative contract that wishes to reduce the exposure to Credit Risk by protecting itself from potential loss suffered as a result of deterioration in the creditworthiness of the reference assets.

title: Protection Seller
content: The Counterparty to a Credit Derivative contract that wishes to take on Credit Risk arises from potential loss suffered as a result of deterioration in the creditworthiness of the reference assets in return for compensation from the Protection Buyer.

title: Providing Credit
content: Has the meaning given in GEN section 2.5.

title: Providing Custody
content: Has the meaning given in GEN section 2.13.

title: Providing Fund Administration
content: Has the meaning given in GEN section 2.24

title: Providing Money Services
content: Has the meaning given in GEN section 2.6.1.

title: Providing Trust Services
content: Has the meaning given in GEN section 2.23.

title: PRU
content: The Prudential Returns module of the Sourcebook.

title: Prudential Context
content: In relation to activities carried on by a Authorised Firm, the context in which the activities might have, or might reasonably be regarded as likely to have, a negative effect on: (a) confidence in the financial stability of the DIFC;

title: PSIA
content: Profit Sharing Investment Account.

title: PSIAr
content: Profit Sharing Investment Account received on a restricted basis.

title: PSIAu
content: Profit Sharing Investment Account received on an unrestricted basis.

title: Public Appearance
content: Any participation in an interview which is part of a seminar, forum, radio, television, website, newspaper, journal, magazine, or other periodical or other public speaking activity, or the writing of an article for a website, newspaper, journal, magazine or other periodical in which an Investment Analyst makes a recommendation or offers an opinion concerning an Investment.

title: Public Fund
content: (1) In relation to a Passported Fund, has the meaning given in FPR section 1.3; and (2) In any other case, has the meaning given in Article 16(1) of the Collective Investment Law 2010.

title: Public Listed Company
content: Has the meaning given in Schedule 1 to the Regulatory Law 2004.

title: Public Listed Company Auditor’s Report
content: A report referred to in MKT Rule 5.2.7(b).

title: Public Property Fund
content: Is a Public Fund which is also a Property Fund

title: Public REIT
content: A Public Fund that is a Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT).

title: Public Sector Entities
content: Bodies owned by central or regional governments or Local Authorities which perform regulatory and other non-commercial functions.

title: QIF
content: Qualified Investor Fund.

title: Qualified Investor Fund
content: Has the meaning given in Article 16(5) of the Collective Investment Law 2010.

title: Qualifying Holding
content: Any holding in the capital of a non-financial Undertaking of which the Authorised Firm is a controller.

title: Quarterly Regulatory Return
content: A quarterly return of the type specified in PIN Rule A10.3.1.

title: Quiet Period
content: In relation to an initial public offering of securities, the period beginning on the day of publication of listing particulars or a prospectus relating to the offering of that Investment and ending 30 days after the day on which the Investment is admitted to trading.

title: RAR
content: The Recovery and Resolution Module of the DFSA Rulebook.

title: Rated
content: In the case of an instrument or a counterparty, assigned a rating by a Rating Agency in respect of the counterparty credit risk associated with the instrument or counterparty.

title: Rating Action
content: Has the meaning given to it in COB Rule 8.3.5(2).

title: Rating Agency
content: Standard & Poor’s, Moody’s, AM Best, Fitch Ratings or another agency approved in writing by the DFSA.

title: Rating Analyst
content: Has the meaning given to it in COB Rule 8.3.1(3).

title: Rating Subject
content: Has the meaning given to it in GEN Rule 2.27.1(3).

title: Readily Realisable Securities
content: A government or public Security denominated in the currency of the country of its issuer, or any other Security which is admitted to official listing on an exchange in a Zone 1 country and regularly traded on or under the rules of such an exchange.

title: Real Estate Investment Trust
content: Has the meaning given in CIR Rule 3.1.8

title: Real Property
content: Land or buildings, whether freehold or leasehold, where the unexpired term of any lease exceeds 20 years.

title: REC
content: The Recognition module of the Rulebook.

title: Recognised Body
content: Has the meaning given in Article 37(3)(a)of the Markets Law 2012.

title: Recognised Crypto Token
content: A Crypto Token which: (a) is included on the Initial List published by the DFSA under section 3A.4; or (b) the DFSA has recognised under Rule 3A.3.4.

title: Recognised Jurisdiction
content: In CIR, in relation to a Foreign Fund, means a jurisdiction which has been recognised by the DFSA under Article 55 of the Collective Investment Law 2010 or, pursuant to Article 1(b) of that law, under Article 20 of the Collective Investment Law 2006. In relation to a Crypto Token or a service or activity

title: Recognised Jurisdiction Notice
content: A notice issued by the DFSA, pursuant Article 55 of the Collective Investment Law 2010 or, pursuant to Article 1(b) of that law, under to Article 20 of the Collective Investment Law 2006, listing countries and territories which are Recognised Jurisdictions and Foreign Funds which are Designated Funds in respect of these jurisdictions.

title: Recognised Member
content: Has the meaning given in Article 37(3)(b) of the Markets Law 2012.

title: Recognised Person
content: A Recognised Body or a Recognised Member.

title: Recognised Professional Body
content: A full member of IFAC.

title: Recognised Professional Qualification
content: A qualification conferred by a Recognised Professional Body.

title: Recognised Supervisory Authority
content: Means any government or quasi-government financial services regulator in a Zone 1 country or such other countries as the DFSA may accept.

title: Recognition
content: The status acquired by a Person who is admitted to the list of Recognised Persons pursuant to Article 37(5) of the Markets Law 2012.

title: Recognition Criteria
content: Has the meaning in REC Rule 2.4 or 2.5.

title: Reference Asset
content: The asset against which payments under a Derivative contract are calculated.

title: Reference Date
content: The date as at which an actuarial investigation is performed for the purposes of PIN section 7.3.

title: Reference Entity
content: The entity against which payments under a Derivative contract are calculated.

title: Registered Auditor
content: Has the meaning given in Article 97 of the Regulatory Law 2004.

title: Registration Statement
content: In relation to a Prospectus structured as multiple documents, the document referred to in MKT Rule 2.5.1(3)(b).

title: Regulated Exchange
content: An exchange regulated by a Financial Services Regulator.

title: Regulated Financial
content: A Person who does not hold a Licence but who is

title: Institution
content: authorised in a jurisdiction other than the DIFC to carry on any financial service by another Financial Services Regulator.

title: Regulation
content: Legislation made under any DIFC law that is not administered by the DFSA.

title: Regulators
content: In addition to the DFSA, regulators with recognised jurisdiction in relation to financial services, whether in the DIFC or outside of the DIFC.

title: Regulatory Announcement Services
content: A service approved by the DFSA for the purposes of making market disclosure of information pursuant to MKT Rule 4.7.1(c).

title: Regulatory Function
content: In accordance with AMI Rule 4.4.1, in relation to an Authorised Market Institution, means those functions which directly contribute to the satisfaction by the Authorised Market Institution of its Licensing Requirements.

title: Regulatory Law
content: The Regulatory Law 2004.

title: Regulatory Returns Auditor’s Report
content: A report referred to in GEN Rule 8.6.1(b).

title: REITS
content: A Real Estate Investment Trust.

title: Related
content: In respect of one entity, the first entity, being in the position relative to that entity of: (a) a second entity that is a Subsidiary, Associate or Holding Company of the first entity; (b) a second entity that is a Subsidiary or Associate of the Holding Company of the first entity; (c) a director or officer of the first entity or of an entity that is related to the first entity by reason of (a) or (b) above; (d) the spouse or minor child of a natural person referred to in (c) above; or (e) a company that is a Subsidiary of or subject to significant influence by or from a natural person referred to in (c) or (d) above.

title: Related Party
content: (1) In MKT, has the meaning given to that term in MKT Rule 3.5.2(a) except in relation to a Rating Subject, where it has the meaning given to it in COB Rule

title: Related Party Transaction
content: (1) in MKT, has the meaning given to that term in MKT Rule 3.5.2(b). (2) in CIR, in relation to a Fund, means: (a) a transaction in respect of Fund Property entered into by a Fund Manager with a Related Party; or (b) in CIR Rule 13.9.5, an arrangement referred to in that Rule relating to an index or benchmark that is entered into by an ETF Fund Manager

title: Related Person
content: Has the meaning given in PIB Rule 4.4.6.

title: Relevant Information
content: Has the meaning given to it in COB Rule 8.3.1(2)

title: Relevant Person
content: (1) In AML, has the meaning in AML Rule 1.1.2. (2) In AUD, has the meaning in AUD Rule 1.1.2.

title: Remuneration
content: Any form of remuneration, including benefits of any kind.

title: Reporting Entity
content: Has the meaning given in Article 38 of the Markets Law 2012.

title: Representative Office
content: A Person carrying on in the DIFC the Financial Service of Operating a Representative Office for which it has authorisation under its Licence.

title: Responsible Officer
content: The Licensed Function described in GEN Rule 7.4.9

title: Restricted Person
content: Has the meaning given to that term in MKT Rule 3.4.1(2).

title: Restricted Profit Sharing Investment Accounts
content: A PSIA in respect of which the investment account holder imposes certain restrictions as to where, how and for what purpose his funds are to be invested.

title: Restricted Speculative Investment
content: Has the meaning given in COB Rule 6.16.2.

title: Retail Client
content: A Client specified under COB Rule 2.3.2.

title: Return
content: Includes both Quarterly Regulatory Returns and Annual Regulatory Returns.

title: Risk Officer
content: The Key Individual function described in AMI Rule 5.3.7.

title: Rule
content: Legislation made by the Board under Article 23 of the Regulatory Law 2004 for the purposes of that law or any law administered by the DFSA.

title: Rulebook
content: The DFSA Rulebook.

title: Safe Custody Crypto Token
content: Means a Client Crypto Token held or to be held for safekeeping by an Authorised Firm or Third Party Agent.

title: Safe Custody Crypto Token Auditor’s Report
content: A report referred to in GEN Rule 8.6.1(f).

title: Safe Custody Investment
content: Means a Client Investment held or to be held for safekeeping by an Authorised Firm or Third Party Agent.

title: Safe Custody Investment Auditor’s Report
content: A report referred to in GEN Rule 8.6.1(e).

title: Safe Custody Provisions
content: The provisions under COB App6.

title: SCA
content: The Securities and Commodities Authority of the UAE.

title: Schedule
content: In the case of a schedule referred to in the MKT module, a schedule that forms part of that module.

title: Scheme
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 2.30.1.

title: Securities Exchange Bid
content: Has the meaning given under Section 1.4 of TKO.

title: Securities Note
content: In relation to a Prospectus structured as multiple documents, the document referred to in MKT Rule 2.5.1(3)(c).

title: Securities Settlement System
content: Pursuant to GEN Rule 2.18.1(4), a system operated by a Person which enables Investments held in accounts to be transferred and settled by book entry according to a set of predetermined multilateral rules.

title: Security
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule A2.1.2.

title: Security Token
content: An Investment Token which is either: (a) a Security specified in GEN Rule A2.1.1(2)(b); or (b) an instrument specified in GEN Rule A2.1.1(2)(c) that confers rights and obligations that are substantially similar in nature to those conferred by a Security, or has a substantially similar purpose or effect to a Security.

title: Segregated Account
content: An account established and maintained in accordance with COB App5.

title: Segregated Client
content: Has the meaning given in COB Rule A5.2.1(2).

title: Self-Custody of Investment Tokens
content: Has the meaning given in COB Rule 14.3.1(c).

title: Senior Executive Officer
content: In relation to: (a) an Authorised Firm, the Licensed Function described in GEN Rule 7.4.2; and (b) an Authorised Market Institution, the Key Individual function described in AMI Rule 5.3.4.

title: Senior Manager
content: In relation to an: (a) Authorised Firm, the Licensed Function described in GEN Rule 7.4.7; and (b) Authorised Market Institution, an individual who is responsible either alone or jointly with other individuals for the management, supervision or control of the Authorised Market Institution’s Financial Services and who is not a member of the Governing Body.

title: Service Provider
content: For the purpose of CIR, a Person who is delegated an activity or outsourced a function by an Fund Manager or Trustee under the terms of a Service Agreement, as described in section 8.12 of CIR but does not include an Incorporated Cell Company that is used by the Fund Manager to perform any function relating to a Fund that is an Incorporated Cell of that ICC.

title: Share
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule A2.2.1(a).

title: Shareholder Statement
content: Means a statement which describes the Share ownership profile of the Applicant prior to listing, summarising the key classes of shareholder and confirming that the Applicant complies with, or will comply with, MKT Rule 9.3.10(1) on its date of admission to the List.

title: Shari’a Supervisory Board
content: The board comprised of individuals appointed by an Authorised Person and entrusted with the duty of directing, reviewing and supervising the activities of the Authorised Person conducting Islamic Financial Business in order to ensure that the Authorised Person in compliance with Shari’a.

title: Short Selling
content: In relation to:

title: Single Family Office
content: Means a Family Office that provides Family Office Services only to one Family.

title: Small or Medium-sized Enterprise
content: In relation to: (a) an Applicant for admission of Shares to the List, has the meaning given in MKT Rule 1.3.3(1); and (b) a Listed Entity that has Shares admitted to the List, has the meaning given in MKT Rule 1.3.3(2).

title: SME
content: A Small or Medium-sized Enterprise.

title: Soft Dollar Agreement
content: An agreement in any form under which an Authorised Firm receives goods or services in return for Investment Business or Crypto Business put through or in the way of another Person.

title: Solvency Reference Date
content: A date at which an Insurer’s compliance with capital adequacy requirements in PIN chapter 4 are assessed.

title: Special Purpose Vehicle
content: (1) In FER 1.2.7(3) and MKT App 5, a legal entity the object and purpose of which is primarily to issue Securities; (2) In relation to Property Investment Crowdfunding, a Body Corporate or a trust that has been established for the purpose of holding title to a property for investors; and (3) In any other case, a Body Corporate whose sole purpose, either generally or when acting in a particular capacity, is to carry out one or more of the following functions: (a) issuing Investments; (b) redeeming or terminating or repurchasing, whether with a view to re-issue or to cancellation, an issue, in whole or par, of Investments; or (c) entering into transactions or terminating transactions involving Investments in connection with the issue, redemption, termination or re- purchase of Investments;

title: Special Resolution
content: (1) In relation to a Domestic Fund, a resolution passed by a majority of not less than 75% of the votes validly cast (whether on a show of hands or on a poll) for and against the resolution at a general meeting or class meeting of Unitholders, of which notice specifying the intention to propose the resolution as a special resolution has been duly given. (2) In relation to a company (that is not a Domestic Fund), a resolution passed by at least seventy five per cent (75%) of the votes of such Shareholders as (being entitled to do so) vote in person or, where proxies are allowed, by proxy, at a general meeting for which notice specifying the intention to propose the resolution has been duly given.

title: Specific Risk
content: The risk that losses on an Authorised Firm’s net long or short position in an individual equity or Security may arise from a negative or positive price movement of that equity or Security relative to the relevant market generally.

title: Sponsor
content: An Authorised Firm that repackages third party assets directly into a securitisation scheme. Where an Authorised Firm repackages non-Investment Grade third party assets, it may fall within the definition of an Originator unless it originates or repackages no more than 10% of the scheme’s total assets.

title: SSB
content: Shari’a Supervisory Board.

title: SSS
content: A Securities Settlement System.

title: Stabilisation Agent
content: A Person appointed by a Stabilisation Manager under PRS Rule 3.4.1 to assist him in conducting Price Stabilisation.

title: Stabilisation Manager
content: A Person appointed by an Issuer of Shares under PRS Rule 3.2.1 to conduct Price Stabilisation.

title: Stabilisation Window
content: The period of time specified in PRS Rule 1.4.1(2) during which Price Stabilisation may occur.

title: State
content: The U.A.E.

title: Statement by Directors
content: The statement described under PIN section A10.5.

title: Statement of Recommended Practice (SORP)
content: The Statement of Recommended Practice as issued and amended from time to time by the Investment Management Association (IMA) in the United Kingdom.

title: Stored Value
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule 2.6.1(2).

title: Stored Value Issuer
content: A Person that issues Stored Value.

title: Structured Product
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule A2.2.1(f).

title: Sub-Fund
content: A separate pool of Fund Property within an Umbrella Fund.

title: Subsidiary
content: Has the meaning given in Schedule 1 to the Companies Law and, without limiting the generality of that definition, is taken to include, in relation to a relevant Body Corporate (the Holding Company), the Holding Company’s ultimate Subsidiary and any Subsidiary between the Holding Company and the Holding Company’s ultimate Subsidiary.

title: Summary
content: The document referred to in MKT Rule 2.5.2(1) or in CIR Rule 14.3.1(d).

title: Supplementary Notes
content: A note which is supplementary to a Return.

title: Supplementary Prospectus
content: An updated or replacement Prospectus produced in accordance with Article 18 of the Markets Law 2012 or Article 52 of the Collective Investment Law 2010, as applicable.

title: Suspicious Activity Report (SAR)
content: Means a report in the prescribed format regarding suspicious activity (including a suspicious transaction) made to the AMLSCU under AML Rule 13.3.1(c).

title: Takaful Insurer
content: An Insurer, any part of whose Insurance Business consists of Takaful transactions.

title: Takeover
content: has the meaning given in the Markets Law 2012.

title: Takeover Principle
content: means a takeover principle prescribed in Section 1.5 of TKO in accordance with Article 53 of the Markets Law 2012.

title: Target
content: includes a Reporting Entity subject to a Bid made under TKO.

title: Target Circular
content: means a document circulated by the Governing Body of a Target in response to a Takeover as described in Section 8.2 of TKO.

title: Third Party Agent
content: In relation to a Client Account, means an Authorised Firm or Regulated Financial Institution (including a bank, custodian, an intermediate broker, a settlement agent, a clearing house, an exchange and ‘over the counter’ counterparty) that is a separate legal entity from the Authorised Firm that is required under COB to establish the Client Account.

title: Third Party Digital Wallet Service Provider
content: (1) In relation to an Investment Token, has the meaning given in COB Rule 14.3.1(b); and (2) In relation to a Crypto Token, has the meaning given in COB Rule 15.4.1.

title: Third Party Service Provider
content: In relation to an Employee Money Purchase Scheme, has the meaning given in COB Rule 12.1.2.

title: Tier 1 Capital
content: Has the meaning given in PIB Rule 3.12.1.

title: TKO
content: the Takeover Rules Module of the Rulebook.

title: Token
content: A cryptographically secured digital representation of value, rights or obligations, which may be issued, transferred and stored electronically, using DLT or other similar technology.

title: Trade Repository
content: Pursuant to GEN Rule 2.2.13, a Trade Repository is a Person who maintains a centralised registry that maintains an electronic database containing records of transactions in Investments and over-the-counter derivatives undertaken by other Persons including Authorised Persons, Recognised Persons and

title: Trading Book
content: The positions and exposures including, on and off- balance sheet items eligible for inclusion in the Trading Book, as described in PIB section 2.2.

title: Transaction
content: Any transaction undertaken by an Authorised Firm in the course of carrying on a Financial Service in or from the DIFC.

title: Trust Administration Services
content: The provision of Trust Administration Services include: (a) the keeping of Accounting Records relating to an express trust and the preparation of trust accounts; (b) the preparation of trust instruments or other documents relating to an express trust; (c) the management and administration of trust assets subject to an express trust; (d) dealing with trust assets subject to an express trust, including the investment, transfer and disposal of such assets; (e) the distribution of trust assets subject to an express trust; and (f) the payment of expenses or remuneration out of an express trust.

title: Trust Deed
content: A deed entered into by an Fund Manager and the Trustee to create an Investment Trust.

title: Trust Law
content: The Trust Law 2018.

title: Trust Service Provider
content: An Authorised Firm which is authorised under its Licence it to carry on the activity of Providing Trust Services.

title: Trustee
content: The Person, described under Article 18 of the Investment Trust Law 2006 who is appointed under a Trust Deed as the trustee of an Investment Trust to hold the Fund’s Property on trust for the Unitholders and to oversee the operation of the Fund and, in relation to a Domestic Fund, is authorised under its License to act as the trustee of the Fund.

title: U.A.E.
content: United Arab Emirates.

title: Umbrella Fund
content: Has the meaning given in CIR Rule 3.1.10

title: Undertaking
content: Means: (a) a Body Corporate or Partnership; or (b) an unincorporated association carrying on a trade or business, with or without a view to profit.

title: Underwriting
content: An arrangement under which a party agrees to buy, before issue, a specified quantity of Securities in an issue of Securities on a given date at a given price, if no other party has purchased or acquired them.

title: Unit
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule A2.2.1(e)

title: Unitholder
content: In relation to a Fund, means any holder of a Unit in the Fund or of any right or interest in such a Unit, and whose name is entered on the Fund’s register in relation to that Unit.

title: Unrestricted Profit Sharing Investment Account
content: A PSIA in respect of which the investment account holder authorises the Authorised Firm to invest the account holder’s funds in a manner which the Authorised Firm deems appropriate without laying down any restrictions as to where, how and for what purpose the funds should be invested.

title: US GAAP
content: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles as issued and amended from time to time by the Financial Accounting Standards Board in the United States.

title: User
content: In relation to Providing Money Services or Arranging or Advising on Money Services, means a Client using that service and includes, in relation to a Payment Service, a Person acting in the capacity of payer, payee or both.

title: Utility Token
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule A2.5.4.

title: Venture Capital Fund
content: Has the meaning given in CIR Rule 3.1.13.

title: Voluntary Bid
content: A Bid made for acquisition of the equity Share capital of a Reporting Entity where there is no obligation to extend a Mandatory Bid.

title: Warrant
content: Has the meaning given in GEN Rule A2.2.1(c).

title: Working Papers
content: Means all material (whether in the form of data stored on paper, film, electronic media or other media or otherwise) prepared by or for, or obtained by a Registered Auditor in connection with, the performance of the audit concerned and includes: (a) the record of audit procedures performed; (b) relevant audit evidence obtained; and (c) conclusions reached.

title: Zone 1
content: Any of the following countries: Australia, Austria, Belgium, Canada, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hong Kong, Iceland, Ireland, Italy, Japan, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Norway, Portugal, Singapore, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, United Kingdom and USA.

title: Zone 2
content: Any country which is not in Zone 1.
